ROMEZETTE — RIGHT MIND RUN

You are Romezette. Three stages, each harder than the last: face the Record Industry Monster, save the day as a DJ, then save the day in your candy blue Cadillac slab. A PantherLyfe Entertainment Global production.

You are Romezette — gold RIGHT MIND shirt, gold pads, black boots, just like the art. A PantherLyfe Entertainment Global production. Tap START and he dances to the real "Right Mind" for the first 4 seconds — arms up, spin and all (tap Skip to jump straight in). Then the run starts.
THE CONTROLS — SIMPLE, NO DRIFT: the track has 3 lanes. Tap ◀ or ▶ on the D-pad and you hop exactly one lane over — no holding, no sliding past, no drift. The big red A button is your only action button — it JUMPS (tap twice mid-air for a double jump). D-pad ▼ ducks under the purple DUCK bars (in the air it dives you back down fast). Hold SPRINT to run faster. That's it — left thumb picks the lane, right thumb jumps.
POPPING IS AUTOMATIC: there is no pop button to mix up with jump. As long as you have ⚡ power, your spark fires on its own the moment a blocker or DUCK bar is in range ahead of you in your lane — and it blasts the Record Industry Monster the same way. Just keep your power stocked.
3 STAGES — EACH ONE HARDER: Stage 1 · The Record Industry Monster: run the Houston track — collect 6 chains, auto-pop 5 blockers — then the giant monster blocks the finish. Your auto-pop blasts it 5 times to drop it — dodge the contracts it throws at you! Stage 2 · Save the Day as a DJ: the club stage runs faster — grab 8 records, auto-pop 7 static bots, and reach the DJ booth. Stage 3 · The Candy Blue Slab: the fastest stage of all — you save the day rolling in your candy blue Cadillac slab on elbows. 10 chains, 8 auto-pops, reach the flag.
A glowing ⚡ pellet gives +5 auto-pop power; grab one while your power is already 3 or more and you raise a 🛡️ FORCE FIELD for 15 seconds — blockers that touch you pop themselves. With the shield down, a bump costs a life and knocks you back. You get 10 lives each stage.
STAGE-CLEAR CELEBRATION: clear any stage and you get a 15-second 3D win scene — Romezette himself dancing and celebrating in that stage's world (under the finish arch, at the DJ booth, beside the candy blue slab) while "Right Mind" plays. A Skip ⏭ button appears at 5 seconds if you want to jump straight to what's next; otherwise it rolls the full 15.
Final win video: clear all 3 stages and the win screen plays the first 60 seconds of the official "Right Mind" video right inside the game — tap play and it counts as a view on YouTube. When the 60 seconds end (or you skip), a big WATCH THE FULL VIDEO button takes you to the whole thing: https://youtu.be/VBIZjCA4Ai0.
🎬 Stage: 1 / 3 ⛓️ Chains: 0 / 6 💥 Popped: 0 / 5 ⚡ Auto-Pop Power: 0 🛡️ Shield: OFF 👹 Monster: 5 ❤️ Lives: 10
